title: IsCentralSimple.baseChange
statement:
% no Lean yet because Lean didn't seem to know L \otimes_K D was a ring
    %    If $D$ is a central simple algebra over~$K$ and $L/K$ is a field extension, then $L\otimes_KD$
    is a central simple algebra over~$L$.
proof: This is not too hard: it's lemma b of section 12.4 in Peirce's "Associative algebras".
